method.method_draft: First transcribe only the static atoms and bonds in the image, ignoring the curved arrows. Convert the lower fragment R1–C≡C–C(OR2)(R3)(R4) by substituting each R label with `*`, yielding `*C#CC(*)(*)O*`. Then transcribe the upper dicobalt carbonyl fragment as two bonded cobalt atoms with eight terminal carbonyl ligands total, each carbonyl written as carbon-bound `C#[O+]`: `[O+]#C[Co](C#[O+])(C#[O+])(C#[O+])[Co](C#[O+])(C#[O+])(C#[O+])C#[O+]`. Join the disconnected organic and metal fragments with a dot to obtain the final SMILES.

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored; no option text is needed.
